# SpecFence vs OCC Soft=0 TPS — mid-band real spine × Opt path tax

**Land:** M1–M5 on PR #39 tip `efe87f2`. Sweep head `578e25b`.
**Method:** `SPECFENCE_ALL_BLOCKS=all` Soft=0, N=3 reuse @8, `profile.release.lto=false`.
**TPS:** `n_tx / wall_seconds` (median of 3). SF/OCC TPS >1 means SpecFence faster.
**Wall:** SF/OCC (median). One empty block (`19910734`, n=0) is listed; TPS aggregates use n>0.

## Aggregates (n>0, 98 blocks)

| metric | value |
|--------|------:|
| loaded / candidates | 99 / 99 |
| Soft=0 every row | yes |
| SF TPS ≥ OCC | **23 / 98** (PR39 28/98) |
| SF/OCC TPS median / p90 / min / mean | 0.832 / 1.120 / 0.311 / 0.816 |
| wall ratio median / p90 / max | **1.202** / 2.195 / 3.220 |
| SF TPS median | 42586 |
| OCC TPS median | 53347 |

Hang-fix-only sweep (`7de412c`, same method) was **27/98**, median TPS ratio **0.861**, wall max **3.49**. This revision keeps that livelock fix and restores empty-wait-set after-publish skip.
